workload: c12h26_sto3g_rhf (38 atoms, 86 contracted STO-3G, direct RHF, core guess, kNormal - the far-field-alive chain fixture)
invocation: /usr/bin/time -v qcx run <run-input TOML derived from the manifest via tools/bench/qcx_runner.WriteRunToml>
capture: GNU time -v 'Maximum resident set size (kbytes)' on stderr
threshold_rule: alert-only (workflow warning annotation) when peak_kib > max(1.5 * baseline_peak_kib, baseline_peak_kib + 512 * 1024); the workflow step never fails the job

history_rows.note: SEED ROW - placeholder estimate (512 MiB), no CI measurement yet. The 86-BF direct-RHF workload models tens of MiB at most, so the placeholder is deliberately loose (first-cut alert-only); a lane replaces this row with a measured one harvested from a CI run's 'perf-guard harvest' line when an accepted change moves the footprint (the reference-pin discipline - the same commit must carry the memory model gate + memory_model_test).
